text:
Alex T: Quick thread — I'm opening a tiny PR to standardize wording around model names/variants. Leaning toward using 'variant' everywhere (short and clear). PR: #4823
Maria G: +1 to 'variant'. matches runtime naming.
Kevin P: +1. One Q: do we also change SDK param names or only docs/examples?
Alex T: Only docs/examples for now. We'll add a migration note for SDK snippets and keep API parameter names unchanged for one sprint.
Samir: Can we also pick a rule for pluralization? Suggest: use 'variant' as the canonical term; use 'variants' only when listing multiple. Avoid 'flavor' entirely. :thumbsup:
Liz H: Agreed. I'll add a style-guide line: "Use 'variant' to refer to model variant identifiers; avoid 'flavor' and 'model flavor'." Happy to PR.
docs-bot: link-checker detected 3 broken anchors in tutorials/ml-serving.md -> anchors: model-variants, variant-routing, variant-api (report: /checks/2026-03-20).
Maria G: I'll fix the anchors and add redirects for old permalinks. Will open PR today (will reference #4823).
Kevin P: For SDK snippets, let's keep the param as `model` in examples (matches present API). Example to show in docs:
```
client.generate(model="redwood-instruct-v1.2", prompt=...)
```
Alex T: Good. Also add a short migration snippet under "API changes" page mapping the old examples to the new phrasing, e.g.:
```
# wording only, not a breaking change
old: client.create_completion(model="redwood-...-v1")
new: client.generate(model="redwood-...-v1")
```
Samir: Don't forget cross-links: glossary -> runtime -> SDK examples. We should add the glossary entry 'variant' with links.
Liz H: I'll update the glossary and include a 'See also' to the runtime docs and API examples. PR #4825 going up after I finish snippets.
Alex T: Action items: Alex will open style-guide PR (#4823), Maria fixes anchors (#4824), Liz updates glossary + snippets (#4825), Kevin to review SDK snippet changes. Target: merge by EOD Friday. Any blockers?
Maria G: No blockers — I have the anchor patches locally.
Kevin P: Will review PRs tomorrow morning.
Alex T: Thanks all. I'll add a short note in the release notes that this is a wording/consistency update only — not an API change. :rocket:
Liz H: One tiny ask — when you update examples, please run the prose linter (docs-ci) so we catch phrasing deviations early.
Alex T: Will do. Posting a follow-up checklist in the PR description.
Maria G: tagging @Liz H in the anchor-fix PR for a quick sanity pass.
Kevin P: After merge, I'll run quick smoke tests on the examples in the SDK repo.
Alex T: Perfect. Closing thread here unless someone sees a missing item. :)
